description:
Two checks on ``myoarm_r``, written to ``docs/validation/shoulder-mechanics.json`` and the generated tables of
``docs/wiki/shoulder-complex.md`` ("Independent validation"):

strength_sources.roy2009: Roy et al. 2009 Table 2, men 18-39 y, dominant side, seated, 45 deg scaption, elbow 90 deg
strength_sources.aronis2025: Aronis et al. 2025 Table 1, men (n = 14), standing, elbow extended, gravity torque added
strength_sources.saul2015: Saul et al. 2015 Table 2, middle-aged men (46-60 y, n = 5), Holzbaur 2007's protocol
strength_sources.otis1990: Otis et al. 1990, 36 young men, as reported in Holzbaur et al. 2005 Fig. 4 (digitised, no spread)
strength_sources.holzbaur2007: Holzbaur et al. 2007 Table 1, men (n = 5), 60 deg abduction, elbow extended
strength_sources.smith2001: Smith et al. 2001 Tables 2-3, men (n = 5), 45 deg scaption, 45 deg external rotation, elbow 90 deg
strength_sources.harbo2012: Harbo et al. 2012 Table 3, men (n = 79), arm at the side
